reason_note: Enter the one-time device code shown here at the provider to authorize this device.
data_exit_note: Aureline shows the code for you to type at the provider; no payload is transmitted by Aureline.

device_code_disclosure.expiry_note: The code expires shortly and is shown with a live countdown.

fallback_note: If the browser does not open, you can enter the device code manually at the provider.

local_continuity.continuity_note: Your work stays open while you authorize the device code.

return_anchor.return_path_truth_note: Once you authorize the code, Aureline continues in this window.

card_summary: Shows a one-time device code and its expiry to enter at the provider, keeping your work local.
notes: Device code and expiry are disclosed in-app; the code is never transmitted by Aureline.
